summary: Frontend-only bug-fix verification for Membership Form: (1) signature pad now captures pointer strokes on web via PanResponder capture handlers + Svg pointerEvents='none' and (2) required-field validation blocks step advance/submit with inline error message. All 7 scenarios in the review request pass end-to-end. Registered a fresh @gmail.com member, navigated Home -> Join Membership, verified: Step 0 (Plan) blocks CONTINUE without a plan and advances after plan selection; Step 1 (Details) blocks CONTINUE while required fields (First name, Last name, DOB, Mobile) are missing (fields pre-fill from useAuth so blocking cascades correctly to DOB / Mobile in this test); Medical step skippable; Step 4 (Waiver) SUBMIT is progressively blocked by media-consent, waiver-agree checkbox, drawn signature, then typed signature name; multi-point mouse-drag on signature-pad registered a signature path (visible SVG stroke rendered) and cleared the signature validation; full happy path reached 'Application submitted!' with testID 'membership-done-btn' visible. No React Native red screen, no console errors on the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: SignaturePad.tsx: Svg has pointerEvents='none' so PanResponder on parent View receives events reliably on web. Draw start/end callbacks correctly toggle parent ScrollView scrollEnabled to avoid scroll interference during drawing.
membership.tsx validateStep is well-structured: step-scoped required fields and clear error strings. Errors are surfaced via `err` state near the CONTINUE/SUBMIT buttons (styles.error).

Note (informational only, not a bug): step 1 first/last name are auto-populated from useAuth().user.name in useEffect, so blank first/last name errors only appear if the registered user's name was empty. Validation logic itself is correct.
Signature is stored as concatenated SVG 'd' path strings; ensure backend accepts arbitrarily long strings (details.signature_path) — no length issue seen during test.
seed_data_creation: Registered 2 fresh members via UI (test_hgtg6fop@gmail.com, test_loy2ji7b@gmail.com) with password 'Password123'. One membership application submitted successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Membership form entrypoint: after login/register -> Home tab -> quick-membership. Signature drawing test uses page.mouse.down()/move()/up() with >=10 intermediate move steps; short drags without an 'L' command are ignored by SignaturePad (onPanResponderRelease requires the path to contain 'L'). testIDs used: plan-<plan_id>, membership-next, m-first, m-last, m-dob, m-mobile, membership-submit, media-consent-yes, waiver-agree, signature-pad, waiver-signature, membership-done-btn.
rca_of_issue: Original bugs verified fixed. Root cause of prior signature-pad failure was that the Svg element captured pointer events (default) preventing the parent View's PanResponder from receiving move events on web; adding pointerEvents='none' on Svg and using PanResponder Capture variants routes gestures to the View. Required-field bug root cause was absence of any validation gate on step transitions; validateStep() now enforces per-step required fields with descriptive error messages before allowing advance/submit.
